job.job_description:
Interested candidates can share their resume to kannamareddy.ramyasrikarthika@bounteous.com




Python Developer (FastAPI/Django/Flask + RAG) | 5-9 Years

We are looking for an experienced Python Developer with strong expertise in backend development and hands-on experience in building




Generative AI/RAG-based applications.

Must Have Skills

5-9 years of experience in Python development
Strong hands-on experience with FastAPI, Django, or Flask
Experience in developing REST APIs and Microservices
Hands-on experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) implementations
Experience integrating LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Llama, Claude, etc.)
Knowledge of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel
Experience with Vector Databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Milvus, Weaviate)
Strong SQL and database knowledge



Good to Have

Azure/AWS/GCP exposure
Docker & Kubernetes
Prompt Engineering
AI Chatbot or Knowledge Assistant development
Agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen)



Keywords

Python, FastAPI, Django, Flask, REST API, Microservices, Generative AI, GenAI, RAG, LLM, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Database, Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, NLP, Prompt Engineering, AI Chatbot.
